productConcept.name: Folia Papers
productConcept.description: Archival fiber-based baryta photographic printing paper for silver gelatin darkrooms, produced in Basel since 1938.
productConcept.rationale: The warm cream palette (#fcf7f1) directly evokes the base paper stock. The compressed spacing (×0.75) produces density without crowding — like a well-composed print sheet. The languid 0.55s hover transitions match the deliberate, unhurried quality of darkroom work. Serif headings (Playfair Display) + uppercase tracked labels (Raleway) create the editorial/technical register of a precision manufacturing brand. The navy accent (#1e3a6e) references chemical bath color. This product is discovered, not default — the aesthetic points toward print culture but the specific territory (photographic darkroom paper) is non-obvious and highly specific.
